reproducibility_gaps.gap: Procurement Pathway (and general recursive web-crawl) source code
reproducibility_gaps.detail: No script producing procurement_pathway_urls.jsonl (1690 URLs, 459 topics x up to 17 lifecycle stages) or the crawl_A_official/crawl_B_bounded/crawl_v2_relevant/crawl_output/corpus_ingest* directories exists anywhere in the current repository checkout. Only outputs and downstream consumers survive.
reproducibility_gaps.impact: Single largest identified source family's acquisition method cannot be rerun, audited step-by-step, or version-matched from this checkout.
reproducibility_gaps.corroborated_by: reproducibility/KNOWN_GAPS_baseline_v1.md, an earlier independent finding of the same gap

boundary_selection_lane.text_provenance_guarantee: code-enforced: chunk text is sliced from immutable source blocks by code, never read from LLM's own text output; validate_plan() rejects incomplete/malformed boundary plans

text_emission_lanes.text_provenance_guarantee: statistical only: 5-token shingle-overlap fidelity check vs source window, default minimum coverage 0.80; chunks failing the check are flagged (fidelity_failed) but still inserted, not excluded

chunking_llm_use.safe_claim_scope: The claim 'LLM selected boundaries but did not rewrite evidence text' is verified true only for the boundary_selection_lane (19.9% of live corpus), not provable for the text_emission_lanes (78.3%).

resolver_scripts: extract_guidance_references.py (GUIDANCE_EXACT / GUIDANCE_ANCESTOR, dominates final edge population)

benchmark_corpus_sufficiency.scope: does required evidence exist anywhere in the corpus -- NOT a retrieval evaluation

uncertain_rows.reason: essential_evidence empty; only strong_supporting_evidence citation, which independently verifies live

benchmark_corpus_sufficiency.conclusion: Corpus completeness is not the binding constraint on this project's separately-evaluated retrieval results (66.7% candidate-generation failures, 8.3% ranking failures, per evaluation/final_retrieval_benchmark/STATIC_BENCHMARK_FINAL_REPORT.md -- computed elsewhere, not re-derived in this audit).

lifecycle_coverage_note: CORPUS_COVERAGE_MATRIX.csv maps the corpus's own free-text, LLM-assigned procurement_stage field (1529 distinct raw values, uncontrolled vocabulary) onto suggested lifecycle categories via keyword matching -- a best-effort derived mapping, not a corpus-native controlled taxonomy. 84.9% of live chunks (18706/22042) carry no procurement_stage tag at all, expected for legislation-source chunks.
